facts.fact_text: In March 2018 the applicants started organising protests against the landfill site at Aleksinskiy Quarry.
All the applicants except Ms Kotova (application no. 106/19) were charged with various administrative offences in connection with their protests against the landfill site.
In November 2017 Mr Kotov submitted three notices of a public event (meeting) to the Klin municipal administration.
Neither of Mr Kotov's applications to the Klin municipal administration for a public event or environmental protest car rally was approved.
